options.label: Minimal state
options.detail: No income tax. Revenue from resources and consumption.

options.label: Flat income tax
options.detail: One rate on all income, few deductions.

options.label: Moderate progressive
options.detail: Progressive rates, a middling take, broad exemptions.

options.label: High, funded by payroll
options.detail: Heavy social contributions on wages alongside income tax.

options.label: Nordic take
options.detail: High broad-based income tax and a high VAT.

options.label: Nordic take plus a departure tax
options.detail: A high broad-based take, and residents pay to leave, subsidising arrivals.

options.label: Private, employer-led
options.detail: Insurance through work, a safety net for the old and poor.

options.label: Compulsory medical savings
options.detail: Everyone saves into their own account and is charged at the point of use.

options.label: Mandatory insurance, regulated market
options.detail: Everyone must buy cover; insurers may not refuse anyone.

options.label: Public with a private tier
options.detail: Universal public cover, and you may pay to go faster.

options.label: Tax-funded national service
options.detail: One service for everyone, free at the point of use and paid for out of general taxation. A private sector exists alongside it, unsubsidised.

options.label: Fees at every level past school
options.detail: Universities set their own prices. Loans, not grants.

options.label: Free at school, deferred fees after
options.detail: Tertiary costs are paid back through the tax system once you earn.

options.label: Free, with an early vocational track
options.detail: Free through university, and most students stream into apprenticeships.

options.label: Free through university
options.detail: No tuition at any level, and a maintenance grant while studying.

options.label: Free, and selective from twelve
options.detail: No tuition, and an exam at twelve decides which school you attend.

options.label: Private market, no state role
options.detail: Housing is built and owned privately. The state zones and nothing else.

options.label: Private market with rent support
options.detail: Cash help with rent rather than housing built by the state.

options.label: Co-operative and non-profit rental
options.detail: A large regulated rental sector run by non-profits, alongside a private market.

options.label: Large social rental sector
options.detail: Non-profit housing associations own close to 29% of the stock and let it below market rent.

options.label: State-built flats, sold to residents
options.detail: The state builds most housing and sells it on long leases. Most people own.

options.label: Private accounts, mandatory
options.detail: Retirement is funded mostly out of your own compulsory fund. The state pension is a floor only.

options.label: Means-tested pension plus mandatory saving
options.detail: A state pension for those who need it, and compulsory employer contributions.

options.label: Flat state pension, saving voluntary
options.detail: The same modest pension for everyone. Private saving is encouraged, not required.

options.label: Earnings-related state pension
options.detail: What the state pays you depends on what you earned.

options.label: Generous earnings-related, early retirement
options.detail: A high replacement rate and a low pension age.

options.label: Cheap fossil power, cars assumed
options.detail: No carbon price. Roads are the transport plan.

options.label: Carbon tax, private cars kept
options.detail: Emissions are priced. People still drive.

options.label: Nuclear baseload
options.detail: Most power from reactors the state builds and guarantees.

options.label: Renewables and heavy public transport
options.detail: A clean grid, and a network good enough that a car is optional.

options.label: Private combustion cars banned
options.detail: Trams and rail carry everyone. Fuel excise, stamp duty and an annual fee price the rest off the road.

options.label: Clean grid and a deposit-return scheme
options.detail: A clean grid and good rail, cars still allowed, and every container carries a refundable deposit.

options.label: Absolute freedom of speech
options.detail: No legal limit on what may be said, including hatred and defamation.

options.label: Near-absolute, narrow exceptions
options.detail: Speech is protected except for incitement and a short list of harms.

options.label: Free, with hate-speech limits
options.detail: Broad protection, and speech attacking a group is a crime.

options.label: Limited where it threatens public order
options.detail: Speech that the state judges divisive or destabilising is restricted.

options.label: State-controlled
options.detail: Criticism of the state and its rulers is prosecuted.

options.label: No competitive national elections
options.detail: Rulers are not chosen at the ballot box.

options.label: First past the post, voluntary
options.detail: One member per seat, most votes wins, turnout is up to you.

options.label: Preferential and compulsory
options.detail: You rank the candidates, and voting is a legal duty.

options.label: Proportional, voluntary
options.detail: Seats match the national vote share. Coalitions are normal.

options.label: Proportional plus binding referendums
options.detail: Any law can be put to a public vote by petition.

options.label: Proportional, with an age cap on representatives
options.detail: Seats match the vote, and nobody may stand past a fixed age.

options.label: At-will employment, thin welfare
options.detail: Easy to hire and fire. Unemployment help is short and conditional.

options.label: Statutory minimums, weak unions
options.detail: The law sets a wage floor and leave. Bargaining is mostly individual.

options.label: Sector-wide bargaining
options.detail: Unions and employers set pay across a whole industry, members or not.

options.label: Sector bargaining, six weeks leave
options.detail: Industry-wide pay deals, and the law guarantees six weeks paid leave and twelve public holidays.

options.label: Universal basic income
options.detail: Every adult gets an unconditional payment. Most other benefits fold into it.

options.label: Sector bargaining, every salary public
options.detail: Industry-wide pay deals, and any salary can be looked up. The viewee sees who looked.

options.label: Neutral, small professional force
options.detail: No alliance, no conscription, a force sized for the border only.

options.label: Small force inside an alliance
options.detail: Defence is shared with allies, so the standing force is modest.

options.label: Neutral, with militia conscription
options.detail: No alliance. Most men serve, then keep their kit and train for years.

options.label: Mandatory service, twelve months
options.detail: Everyone serves. The force is large relative to the population.

options.label: Global force projection
options.detail: Bases abroad, a blue-water navy, and the spending that goes with them.

options.label: Very low intake, citizenship by descent
options.detail: Few people move in, and being born there is how you become a citizen.

options.label: Controlled intake, long path to citizenship
options.detail: Selective entry, and naturalisation takes the better part of a decade.

options.label: High skilled intake, real path to citizenship
options.detail: A points system brings people in, and most of them can become citizens.

options.label: Very high intake, no path to citizenship
options.detail: Most residents are foreign workers on visas that never lead anywhere.

options.label: Open borders within a bloc
options.detail: Anyone from the union may live and work without a visa.

options.label: Rehabilitation, short sentences
options.detail: Prison is a last resort and the maximum term is low. Few people are inside.

options.label: Mixed, moderate sentences
options.detail: Prison for serious crime, community sentences below it.

options.label: Long sentences, high imprisonment
options.detail: Long terms, limited parole, and a large prison population.

options.label: Severe penalties, caning and capital punishment
options.detail: Harsh punishments for a wide range of offences, and very low crime.

options.label: Rehabilitation, drugs decriminalised
options.detail: Short sentences and a small prison population, and possessing any drug is treated as a health matter rather than a crime.

options.label: No state support
options.detail: Childcare and leave are between you and your employer.

options.label: Payments to those who need them
options.detail: Means-tested help with childcare and a modest paid leave scheme.

options.label: Universal child benefit and cheap childcare
options.detail: Every family is paid per child, and childcare is capped at a low price.

options.label: Payments to have more children
options.detail: Large transfers, loans forgiven per child, tax relief for big families.

options.label: Universal, with a long shared parental leave
options.detail: Every family gets a per-child benefit and capped-price childcare, plus more than a year of paid leave split between parents.
